capabilities: Run shell commands in sidebar cards with live streaming output
Stop processes with whole-tree termination on Windows
List and bulk-clear unresolved wikilinks across the vault
Visualize vault scan history as a pannable, zoomable tree canvas
Install and uninstall Claude skills from remote repositories
disambiguation: Despite the process-runner name, it also bundles wikilink flattening, a scan-history canvas, and a Claude skills installer.
extras: Desktop only; child processes are unavailable in the Obsidian mobile sandbox. README warns not to run untrusted commands since shell syntax is fully supported. Community-store listing noted as pending publication and not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, so developers must leave the app to run and monitor commands like npm run dev while taking notes.

relations.evidence: Install Claude skills into the vault — install any skill from a degit source

summary: Runs local shell commands from a sidebar with live output, plus unresolved-wikilink inspection, a repair-history tree, and Claude skill installation.
